title: Item:Bottle of Mist
wikitext:
{{Nonconsumable | name = Bottle of Mist | picdesc = Bottle of Mist.png | acquired = [[Rex'nall]] ** Available with [[Mists of Ravenloft]] Ultimate Fan Bundle ** [[DDO Store]] *** [[Escape to Ravenloft: Complete Collection]] *** [[Escape to Ravenloft: Utility Collection]] *** [[Escape to Ravenloft: Barovian Aristocrat]] *** [[Escape to Ravenloft: Vampire Hunter]] | location = Eberron [[Hall of Heroes]] | minlevel = 1 | bind = {{Bind|BtA|BoA}} | effect = Clicky: {{Clicky|Expanded Teleport|7|no|N/A}} | cost = 300 pp | weight = 0.01 lbs | description = Mist swirls within this tiny bottle, filling you with dread.

This item is capable of Teleporting you to a variety of locations depending on what you've unlocked.

This item has a one-minute cooldown as the mists gather back into the bottle. | notes = ** Ownership of this item unlocks the [[Blood on the Vine Tavern]] destination for Expanded Teleport. *** If you have not yet completed the quest [[Into the Mists]] this life, this item will not send you to the advertised destination. It will instead place you in [[House Jorasco]], near the entrance to that quest. ** As of [[Update 80]], the cooldown is 20 seconds, but {{bug|this is not reflected in the description|term=}}. | Category1 = DDO Store items }}
